title: PH60412: Introduction To Oceans
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Overview of the Oceans, Properties of sea water- Surface Temperature, Salinity
and Density, Ocean Head Budget- Direct and indirect calculation of fluxes,
Ocean Dynamics- Equations of Motion, Response of Upper Ocean to Wind Stress,
Ekman Transport, Ocean Circulation- Wind Driven circulation, Sverdrup Theory,
Deep circulation in the world ocean, Ocean Waves- Linear Wave Theory, Ocean
Wave Spectrum, Tides, Coastal Processes- Storm Surges, Tsunamies, Ocean
Atmospheric Interaction- El Nino Southern Oscillation.
